items.title: CVE-2026-83844 Windows Paint Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: To comprehensively address the vulnerability identified by this CVE, Microsoft has released a new version of Paint with build version number 11.2609.401.0. Microsoft recommends installing this new version or ensuring that it was automatically updated.

items.summary: This CVE was assigned by Chrome. Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) ingests Chromium, which addresses this vulnerability. Please see [Google Chrome Releases](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026) for more information.
